newsitem.title: USA: CBOT expands rough rice limit, margins.
newsitem.headline: CBOT expands rough rice limit, margins.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade said that performance margins and trading limits for rough rice futures will be expanded, effective on Wednesday, Feb 5.
The moves follow a limit-down close on Tuesday on what traders called speculative profit-taking.
Daily trading limits will be expanded to 45 cents per cwt from the normal 30 cents for a minimum two trading days from the start of trading in the day session on Feb 5, it said.
Margins were raised to reflect the expanded trading range, with initial maintenance margin per contract now $1,013 and maintenance and hedge margin at $750.
On Tuesday, March rice closed down the 30-cent limit at $11.80-1/2 per cwt.
